description: Final-version samples reused from the completed two-host experiment; 3 repetitions per condition. See BENCHMARK.md for interpretation.
rps: nginx received requests/s, monitor requests subtracted, common steady window; not client completed requests/s
pps: HP NIC hardware packet counters/s; RX = client to server, TX = server to client; small background traffic included
errors: Full-run native counters; tool definitions and runtime differ. RST is not included in dperf httpErr/skErr.
